item.title: Latest on the Iran War: U.S. Fires on Tankers as Tehran Accuses Washington of ‘Reckless’ Attacks
item.description: Iran’s foreign minister accused Washington of undermining diplomacy. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the U.S. expected to hear from Tehran on Friday.

item.title: U.A.E. Expels Pakistani Workers, as Pakistan’s Peacemaking Creates a Rift
item.description: As Pakistan mediates between the U.S. and Iran, its ties to the Emirates have deteriorated. Pakistani workers say they are now being sent home en masse.

item.title: Starmer’s Party Suffers Stark Losses in U.K. Local Elections
item.description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer took responsibility as Labour lost more than a thousand municipal seats but insisted he would not resign.

item.title: Takeaways From the 2026 U.K. Local Elections
item.description: Results from municipal and regional elections signaled major gains for the right-wing populist Reform U.K. and steep losses for Labour.
